notes: *take our fill of* is one light-verb rendering of נִרְוֶה, headed on *fill*; *our* realizes the cohortative's own person and number and is not a supplied possessive (rules 44 and 17).
The paragogic he is its own unrepresented unit (rule 32); the reflexive *ourselves* renders the Hithpael's voice and stays with עָלַס (rule 44).
